notes: This file encodes the kit's own test-kit/mapping.md at b6587950, which keeps the R1, R5 and R6 defaults of 4a028675ef and changes R6 to join and deduplicate on receipt.id within the service and tenant scope.

Scope is the issuing system read from resource attribute service.name, qualified by resource attribute tenant.id where a record carries one (identity rule 4, contract line 49). A record without tenant.id has the unqualified system scope, as at 4a028675ef. The kit's mapping.md says tenant.id is a fixture choice for the scope representation the draft leaves open; this file reads it only because that mapping.md names it.
A qualified scope is rendered system@tenant. A service.name or tenant.id containing '@' is an unreadable scope (a loss), so the rendering is never ambiguous.

R6 on a receipt still applies only in test-ticket-service (source_scope compares the system part). receipt.action_id is read as a reference to the proposed action issued by support-agent in the receipt's own tenant (key_scope tenant same_as_source); the system name support-agent stays this reader's declaration (FINDINGS F4).

answer_fields names receipt.ticket_id, so an effect view reports the ticket ids its receipt records state (kit README: a count or receipt id alone cannot answer the ticket-id question). Different ticket ids on one receipt key are kept as observations and the effect count becomes conflict, never a chosen value.
evidence.externally_verified and receipt.signature stay unplaced, as at 4a028675ef.
